newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebels 100 km from Kinshasa -church sources.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebels 100 km from Kinshasa -church sources.

text.p: Zairean rebels on Sunday advanced to within 100 km (60 miles) of the capital Kinshasa, church sources in radio contact with residents of the area said.
"The rebels are coming by vehicle, and the people of Kenge say many big trucks have left there carrying around 100 to 150 people each," one church source said.
Residents earlier reported that rebel fighters had been massing at Kenge, 200 km (125 miles) east of the capital on the main road.

A final communique issued after talks between Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila on board a South African navy ship on Sunday said Mobutu had offered to hand over power to an elected successor.
But Kabila told Reuters that his troops would fight on while Mobutu considered a rebel demand that he quit.

A mining manager in rebel-held Lubumbashi earlier said rebels had pushed to within 40 miles (65 km) from the airport. The airport is around 25 km (16 miles) from the city centre along the road to Kenge.
